# Pergola Pro

> Premium outdoor living specialists designing and installing custom aluminum pergolas, motorized louvre roof systems, canopies, carports, outdoor roller blinds, premium fencing, and decking solutions. Serving residential and commercial clients across Tauranga, the Bay of Plenty, and the Waikato region.

Pergola Pro provides fully engineered, custom-designed outdoor structures built to withstand New Zealand's coastal climate. We manage the entire lifecycle from architectural design and council consent navigation to professional, warrantied on-site installation.

## Core Services

- [Pergolas](https://pergolapro.co.nz/services/pergolas/): Custom residential and timber/aluminum pergolas designed for NZ lifestyles.
- [Louvre Roof Systems](https://pergolapro.co.nz/services/louvre-roof-systems/): Automated, adjustable opening louvre roofs for all-weather outdoor entertainment.
- [Canopies](https://pergolapro.co.nz/services/canopies/): Fixed acrylic and flexible retractable canopy solutions for UV and rain protection.
- [Carports](https://pergolapro.co.nz/services/carports/): Durable, modern vehicle protection and standalone carport structures.
- [Roller Blinds](https://pergolapro.co.nz/services/roller-blinds/): External track-guided outdoor blinds and indoor window treatments for wind and privacy control.
- [Fencing & Decking](https://pergolapro.co.nz/services/fencing-decking/): Premium timber and composite decking alongside architectural boundary fencing.

## Regional Service Areas

- [Tauranga](https://pergolapro.co.nz/pergola-tauranga/): Local outdoor structure installations in central Tauranga and surrounding suburbs.
- [Papamoa](https://pergolapro.co.nz/pergola-papamoa/): Coastal-grade pergolas and louvres built for Papamoa's microclimate.
- [Rotorua](https://pergolapro.co.nz/pergola-rotorua/): Residential and commercial outdoor living solutions across Rotorua.
- [Whakatāne](https://pergolapro.co.nz/pergola-whakatane/): Custom weather-protected canopies and structures for Whakatāne homes.
- [Opotiki](https://pergolapro.co.nz/pergola-opotiki/): Fixed canopy and pergola building services in Opotiki.
- [Matamata](https://pergolapro.co.nz/pergola-matamata/): Rural and residential outdoor entertainment spaces in Matamata.
- [Putāruru](https://pergolapro.co.nz/pergola-putaruru/): Structural renovations and custom outdoor roof builds in Putāruru.
- [Waihi](https://pergolapro.co.nz/pergola-waihi/): Durable outdoor blinds and pergola setups across Waihi.
- [Katikati](https://pergolapro.co.nz/pergola-katikati/): Engineered solutions for lifestyle blocks and homes in Katikati.
- [Thames](https://pergolapro.co.nz/pergola-thames/): Coromandel-adjacent canopy and louvre engineering services in Thames.
- [Paeroa](https://pergolapro.co.nz/pergola-paeroa/): Local fencing, decking, and shade structure installs in Paeroa.
- [Pyes Pa Lakes](https://pergolapro.co.nz/pergola-pyes-pa-lakes/): High-end modern louvre and blind fits for Pyes Pa residential developments.

## Featured Articles & Guides

- [Do You Need Council Consent for a Pergola in New Zealand?](https://pergolapro.co.nz/blog/pergola-council-consent-nz/): Complete legal guide to NZ building exemptions and council consent limits for pergolas.
- [Pergola Trends 2026: The Ultimate Guide to Modern Outdoor Living in New Zealand](https://pergolapro.co.nz/blog/modern-pergola-trends-2026/): Latest technical design, integration, and color trends for NZ properties.
- [A Buyer's Guide for Best Roller Blinds in Tauranga](https://pergolapro.co.nz/blog/buyers-guide-roller-blinds/): Material comparison and wind-rating guide for selecting exterior blinds.
- [How Much Does a Pergola Cost in Tauranga?](https://pergolapro.co.nz/blog/pergola-installation-cost-tauranga/): Comprehensive pricing breakdown for engineering, materials, and labor in the Bay of Plenty.
- [Top 5 Pergola Design Ideas for NZ Homes](https://pergolapro.co.nz/blog/top-pergola-design-ideas/): Architectural inspiration tailored to architectural styles in New Zealand.

## Business Information

- [Project Gallery](https://pergolapro.co.nz/gallery/): Photo documentation of real-world residential and commercial installations.
- [About Us](https://pergolapro.co.nz/about-us/): Our team, construction standards, and product warranties.
- [Book a Consultation](https://pergolapro.co.nz/contact/): Request a site visit, measurements, and a detailed project quote.

### Contact Details

- **Physical Address:** 11 Aurora Avenue, Welcome Bay, Tauranga 3175, New Zealand
